task: Migrate Fast Debug and Native static call dispatch to checker-issued SpecId call rows.
observation: The first combined identity repro gate showed that exact call-edge lookup itself fails closed, but static body resolution also fails when ProgramSpecializationIdentity.semantic_callable_identity is module-prefixed while Function.semantic_callable_id remains the canonical unqualified callable identity. Fast Debug and Native both compare those identities exactly, so the same producer mismatch prevents SpecId-to-body mapping. A separate module_identity field is already available and should carry module provenance.
impact: One producer identity mismatch explains multiple consumer reproduction failures; consumer-side suffix parsing or relaxed matching would hide the contradiction and violate exact checker authority.

resolution.summary: Producer checkpoint 7252ae35 corrected canonical callable identity and split method body SpecIds. Later exact repros still expose missing ReturnValue/call-edge producer rows; those remain fail-closed.

task: Thread exact EST call occurrences through Native method result lowering.
observation: For `carrier.Echo(payload).value`, Native's active cursor is the outer EST Member node `.value`; the checked method Call is its base child. Passing the outer cursor directly makes the exact selector reject a valid method body. Traversing the Member's base edge to the Call ExprId allows Native lowering to use the checker call row without source/name reconstruction. Fast Debug separately exposed missing call authority for object constructor Call nodes (`Carrier()` and imported `provider.Carrier()`), which remains a producer/API dependency.
impact: Nested member access after a method result needs structural child-cursor traversal; object construction currently has no consumable exact call authority in Fast Debug and must remain fail-closed until the checker defines it.

resolution.summary: Native cursor traversal was implemented and native provider build now passes this shape. Fast Debug still fails closed on constructor Call ExprId 16 (local fixture) / line 4 (imported fixture); Team A has been asked for the exact constructor authority API.
